items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: I would play in the afternoons at the Metropole, in the Metropole Cafe along 7th Avenue with guys like Charlie Shavers, Coleman Hawkins, Roy Eldridge

ctx.x: What was the jazz atmosphere in ‘59, at that time, 52nd Street kind of had come and gone.

Yeah, right. Well I’ll tell you when I first came here I did things like I would play in the afternoons at the Metropole, in the Metropole Cafe along 7th Avenue with guys like Charlie Shavers, Coleman Hawkins, Roy Eldridge, other guys who were playing there, Red—
